players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: On IR after right thumb surgery was confirmed, with the absence possibly season-ending. Without him and Tyler Huntley (turf toe, out for the season), Baltimore lost 33-10 to Jacksonville on TNF Nov. 5 with rookie Joe Fagnano at QB.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: The Cardinals-Ravens trade was still being finalized as of Nov. 5, and ESPN expects it to be completed this weekend. He is in line to start for Baltimore in Week 10 after Fagnano threw for 60 yards and 2 INTs on TNF.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Kevin O'Connell said Nov. 5 that Murray has a hamstring strain and is week to week, so Carson Wentz will start Monday night vs. Buffalo. Murray is not headed to IR, but O'Connell wouldn't say who starts beyond this week.

players.name: Carson Wentz
players.note: Named the Vikings' Week 9 starter on Nov. 5 for Monday night vs. Buffalo, with Kyler Murray (hamstring) week to week. Buffalo allows the third-most passing yards per game, and Wentz could keep the job beyond this week.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: Confirmed as the Eagles' Week 9 starter vs. the Giants (reported Nov. 4-5), replacing Tanner McKee after six straight losses. This will be his first NFL start, and his rushing gives him streamer upside.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: Benched for Joe Milton ahead of Week 9 (Nov. 4) after the Eagles lost all three of his starts. Sleeper also lists him as questionable with a ribs injury as of Nov. 5.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Ruled out for Week 9 vs. Arizona (quad, plus a cracked rib), per Mike Macdonald on Nov. 4. He is week to week but not going on IR, and Drew Lock (elbow, limited Wed/Thu) is expected to start.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: Backs up Drew Lock for Week 9 vs. Arizona with Sam Darnold out. Lock was limited in practice Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 4-5) with a right elbow injury, so Milroe would make his first start if Lock can't go.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: Still in the concussion protocol as of Thursday, Nov. 5. Coach Todd Monken said the Week 9 game plan vs. New Orleans was built with Shedeur Sanders as the starter.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: Expected to start Week 9 at New Orleans with Deshaun Watson still in the concussion protocol (Nov. 5). Todd Monken said the game plan was built around Sanders, though it is not yet official.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.note: Named Arizona's starter 'moving forward' and starts Week 9 at Seattle, with rookie Carson Beck as QB2. Jacoby Brissett is an emergency third QB pending his trade to Baltimore.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Tuten played through his ankle/foot injury in Thursday's 33-10 win at Baltimore (Nov. 5) but managed only 29 yards in an abbreviated workload, per PFF and Rotowire. Chris Rodriguez Jr. vultured the late rushing TD.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: In the Nov. 5 win at Baltimore, Rodriguez ran 10 times for 19 yards and a late 2-yard TD, adding 2 catches for 13 yards, while Bhayshul Tuten played through an ankle/foot injury.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Henry managed 57 yards (per PFF) in the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville on Nov. 5, with third-string QB Joe Fagnano starting (57 passing yards) and Lamar Jackson on IR. Expect stacked boxes until Jacoby Brissett takes over in Week 10.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: McCaffrey (hamstring) returned to practice as a limited participant Thursday (Nov. 5) after sitting out Wednesday, and reporters expect him to play Sunday vs. Las Vegas. Friday's report will give his final designation.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring/back) practiced Thursday (Nov. 5) after missing Wednesday, and he looks on track to play Sunday vs. the Giants.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo (hamstring) missed practice again Thursday (Nov. 5), working on the side with trainers. He is still day-to-day and looks doubtful to face Philadelphia on Sunday.

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) missed practice again Thursday (Nov. 5), so Singletary is likely to lead the Giants' backfield Sunday vs. Philadelphia with Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (illness) missed practice again Thursday (Nov. 5) and hasn't practiced since last Wednesday, so he could miss a second straight game Sunday vs. Green Bay.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) missed practice again Thursday (Nov. 5) and could miss Sunday vs. Green Bay, which would leave Stevenson as New England's lead back.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (thumb/toe) did not practice Thursday (Nov. 5) after missing Week 8, so he is trending toward sitting again in Week 9.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not practice Thursday (Nov. 5), so Swift should lead Chicago again after his 27-carry, 3-TD game on Nov. 2.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: As of Nov. 5, Taylor had not been traded. The Colts are open to a deal before the Nov. 10 deadline but want a 'McCaffrey-esque' package, and they have turned down a second-round pick plus another pick. The Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks are interested.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: Indianapolis is still open to trading Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, and a deal would make McGowan the Colts' lead back.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Mike Florio reports that multiple teams have shown interest in Pollard ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline. He played 82% of the snaps in Week 8 with Tyjae Spears (knee) out.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) missed Week 8 (Nov. 1) and is listed as out, with no return timeline reported.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Hampton is the listed starter for Sunday vs. Houston (Nov. 8), and Yahoo reports he is expected to get more touches. His role had shrunk into a three-back committee with Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell, and he has run for 45 or fewer yards in four straight games.

players.name: Kimani Vidal
players.note: Vidal is part of the Chargers' three-back committee with Omarion Hampton and Keaton Mitchell, but Hampton is expected to get more touches Sunday vs. Houston (Nov. 8), per Yahoo, which squeezes Vidal's share.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Despite Dave Canales' Nov. 2 comments, the Panthers will not open Brooks' (core muscle) practice window yet, per CBS. He stays on IR with no return in sight.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Breece Hall (quad) is trending toward returning Sunday vs. Kansas City after five straight inactive games and is no longer on Sleeper's injury report, which cuts into Allen's lead role.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Week 9 vs. the Chargers (Nov. 4) and will miss a third straight game.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With David Montgomery (groin) ruled out, Marks will lead Houston's backfield again Sunday at the Chargers (Nov. 8).

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman out-snapped J.K. Dobbins 40-14 on Nov. 1 and is Denver's lead back while RJ Harvey (knee) is on IR. CBS's Week 9 cheat sheet calls him borderline must-start.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played only 14 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 40 on Nov. 1, with 7 carries for 13 yards, and has lost Denver's lead role.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) has been on short-term IR since Oct. 31, and Jonah Coleman's breakout threatens his role when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Arizona placed Love (high ankle sprain) on IR on Nov. 3, and he is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Jeremiyah Love on IR for 4-5 weeks (placed Nov. 3), Allgeier leads Arizona's backfield after scoring twice on Nov. 1.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight (concussion) is questionable and must clear protocol before Week 9. If healthy, he is the No. 2 behind Tyler Allgeier while Jeremiyah Love is on IR.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Klint Kubiak said Nov. 4 that the Jeanty/Mike Washington Jr. split will be set week to week. After Jeanty had just 2 carries in Week 8, he projects mostly as the passing-down back at San Francisco.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Washington took 25 carries for 83 yards as the Week 8 starter (Nov. 1) and is the early-down favorite for Week 9 at San Francisco, per Kubiak's week-to-week comments on Nov. 4.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon played 80% of the snaps for a second straight week on Nov. 1 and is Miami's clear lead back while De'Von Achane is on IR.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: Price led Seattle with 10 carries to Zach Charbonnet's 6 in his Nov. 2 return from IR, so the backfield looks like a committee.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists Robinson (hamstring) as out for Week 9, after he missed two straight games without practicing.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara's Week 9 listing was for rest (not injury related) on the Nov. 4 report, so there's little concern for Sunday.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Sleeper lists him as questionable (knee) as of Nov. 5.

players.name: Kaytron Allen
players.note: Sleeper lists him as questionable (quadriceps) as of Nov. 4.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (knee/ankle) missed practice again Thursday (Nov 5), his third straight absence this week, and Mike Vrabel sidestepped a question about returning him to IR. A Week 9 return vs. Green Bay looks unlikely.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: A.J. Brown missed practice again Thursday (Nov 5) and Romeo Doubs is on IR, so Douglas is set to stay one of New England's top targets vs. Green Bay on Sunday.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson has been in the concussion protocol since Nov 4 and must clear an independent consultant. Reports lean toward the Jets playing at Kansas City on Sunday without him.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Garrett Wilson remains in the concussion protocol (entered Nov 4) and is trending toward missing Week 9 at Kansas City. That would make Mitchell (7-142-1 in Week 8) the Jets' lead receiver alongside Omar Cooper Jr.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Williams led Washington in routes, targets and catches in the Nov 1 win over Philadelphia. He remains the Commanders' WR2 behind Stefon Diggs for Week 9.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) missed Week 8, and Tennessee is on bye in Week 9. He is expected back for Week 10 vs. Jacksonville on Nov 15.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Watson (ribs) was limited again Thursday (Nov 5) but practiced in pads. Reports say signs point to him playing Sunday vs. New England.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Moore was a limited participant Thursday (Nov 5); reports list the injury as a shoulder or a knee. Buffalo plays Monday night vs. Minnesota, which gives him an extra day to get ready.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quad) has been listed doubtful for Week 9 since Nov 4 after missing Week 8. The injury is a recurrence of the quad problem that cost him Weeks 3-5.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday (Nov 5). He is trending toward missing a third straight game, Week 9 vs. the Giants.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) was absent from practice again Thursday (Nov 5) and is considered unlikely to play Sunday vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: St. Brown (ribs) was limited for the second straight day Thursday (Nov 5). If he logs a full practice Friday, he could come off the report before Sunday's game at Miami.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Pickens (hamstring) was limited again Thursday (Nov 5) and is no longer listed with a shoulder injury. The hamstring is not expected to keep him out Sunday at Indianapolis.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Boston (calf) was limited in Wednesday's practice (Nov 4) before Cleveland's Week 9 game at New Orleans. His game status is unresolved.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Thomas played only 19 of 56 snaps (34%) and had zero targets in the 33-10 TNF win at Baltimore (Nov 5). He has one catch over Jacksonville's last four games, and he remains a trade-deadline (Nov 10) candidate even though the Jaguars have played down a deal.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Meyers led Jacksonville with 4 catches for 65 yards on 6 targets in the 33-10 TNF win at Baltimore (Nov 5), while Brian Thomas Jr. was shut out.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings is questionable with a calf injury as of Nov 5. CBS reports that San Francisco's trade attempt fell apart after he refused a FaceTime call with Kyle Shanahan and John Lynch, though ESPN still lists him as a possible mover before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Rookie QB Joe Fagnano went 10-of-18 for 60 yards and two interceptions in the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville (Nov 5), with Lamar Jackson now on IR. CBS reports Baltimore traded for Jacoby Brissett, but the Ravens' passing outlook stays poor.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was inactive (coach's decision) for the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville (Nov 5). Baltimore's offense is down to rookie QB Joe Fagnano, with Jacoby Brissett reportedly acquired by trade.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard is Pittsburgh's WR2 with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR, but the Steelers are on bye in Week 9 and are linked to a receiver trade before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring. Sean McVay has given a 6-10 week timeline, and CBS projects a return around Week 12.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury, and as of Nov 5 Indianapolis has not opened his practice window.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.note: Higgins is on IR with a season-ending ACL injury. Houston also acquired Marvin Harrison Jr. from Arizona this week, which crowds his future role.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Flowers caught 3 of 6 targets for 6 yards and ran 3 times for 17 yards in Thursday's 33-10 loss to Jacksonville (Nov 5), with undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano starting at QB. That follows a catchless prior game; Baltimore is finalizing a trade for QB Jacoby Brissett.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington took a slant 50 yards for a touchdown in Jacksonville's 33-10 TNF win at Baltimore on Nov 5.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) was designated to return from IR on Nov 4 and was limited again in Thursday's Nov 5 practice. He has not been activated yet; reports say he could debut Sunday vs. Cleveland, but that is uncertain.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles) missed practice again Thursday, Nov 5, and Rotoworld reports he is unlikely to play in Week 9 vs. the Raiders.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) did not practice Thursday, Nov 5, and is in danger of missing a second straight game.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: Nabers did not practice Thursday, Nov 5, with a knee injury ahead of Week 9 at Philadelphia.

players.name: Keon Coleman
players.note: Coleman (shoulder) was limited in Thursday's Nov 5 practice. Buffalo plays Monday at Minnesota, which gives him extra time.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson (ribs/rest) was limited again in Thursday's Nov 5 practice and is still expected to play through broken ribs. Kendrick Bourne's IR placement (Nov 3) leaves more targets for him.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring/knee) was a full participant in Thursday's Nov 5 practice and is on track to play vs. the Jets.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: With Rice practicing fully (Nov 5), Kansas City is still widely expected to add a receiver before the Nov 10 deadline. That would push Worthy further down the target pecking order.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Recent reports say Hill is 'not healthy enough' and that a civil jury found him liable on two domestic-violence-related counts. A Chiefs reunion now looks unlikely this season, with Kansas City expected to trade for a different receiver.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: CBS Sports reports that Downs has officially requested a trade from the Colts ahead of the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed Week 8 on Nov 1, and no practice participation had been reported this week as of Nov 5.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Henry (foot) missed practice again Thursday, Nov 5, after sitting out Wednesday. Reports say that unless he practices in some capacity Friday, he will likely be ruled out for Sunday vs. Green Bay.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.note: Hunter Henry (foot) missed practice Wednesday and Thursday (Nov 4-5) and is trending toward sitting Week 9 vs. Green Bay. That would leave Raridon, who played 92% of snaps in Week 8, as New England's lead TE.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (low-ankle sprain) missed Wednesday's Nov 4 practice and is questionable for Sunday at Indianapolis. Brevyn Spann-Ford would lead the TEs if he sits, and even if he plays he projects as a TD-dependent TE2.

players.name: Mark Andrews
players.note: Baltimore lost 33-10 to Jacksonville on TNF (Nov 5) as third-string QB Joe Fagnano threw for just 60 yards with two INTs, and Andrews fumbled a late fourth-down snap. The Ravens' next game is Nov 16 vs. the Chargers, with newly acquired Jacoby Brissett expected to start.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle, IR) was limited again Thursday, Nov 5, his second practice since his 21-day window opened. He likely needs a full practice Friday to be activated for Sunday at Washington, and would rejoin a crowded TE rotation.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Kincaid (chest) is listed as questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 5. He was limited with the same chest injury in late October practices.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Fannin (groin) is listed as questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 5. He had offseason groin surgery, so the injury is worth watching ahead of Sunday.
